scope: Implemented local handler contract; not a deployment or remote calculator approval
query_parameters: nonempty single or multi query maps are rejected before routing/authentication
implemented_wait: No in-process wait; queued/processing responses are early 202 with wait_expired=false
attempt_path_parameter: lowercase hexadecimal UUID-shaped 8-4-4-4-12 string; handler does not restrict UUID version

routes.measurement_error: HTTP 400 legacy type/client_error and sanitized message; attempt route retains 422

PROGRAM_ALREADY_COMPLETED.message: This program and target are already completed.

IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.message: The request identifier has different input.

ATTEMPT_INPUT_CONFLICT.message: The attempt already has different input.

PROFILE_MISMATCH.message: The attempt profile does not match.

INVALID_STATE.message: The operation is not allowed in this state.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.message: The request exceeds the verified payload limit.

CALCULATOR_CONTRACT_MISMATCH.message: The calculator contract is not verified.

STORED_INPUT_INVALID.message: The stored input could not be verified.

CALCULATION_FAILED.message: The calculation could not be completed.

dependencies: JourneyStorage with explicit S3 client and legacy bindings
roles.runtime_status: Configuration opt-in can build control-only JourneyService with Catalog() lacking execution definitions; no complete calculation runtime is wired

events: SQS Records containing only a job_id reference
dependencies: JourneyStorage with explicit S3 client and legacy bindings
roles.runtime_status: get_worker raises CALCULATOR_CONTRACT_MISMATCH; dependency-injected local execution only

events: DynamoDB Stream keys and sequence numbers
dependencies: DynamoJobRepository with explicit table binding and the existing fixed GSI1 due index
roles.runtime_status: get_relay raises TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE; dependency-injected local execution only

deployment_review_required: Per-team-member test access protection ahead of every mock route including login; the application does not implement this outer identity provider
Prevent direct unauthenticated invocation of legacy lambda_handler.run or alternate deployment routes
REST proxy header/body/base64 preservation and ingress payload/timeout enforcement
Actual deployment configuration and complete program definitions require separate verification
Role identities, resource identifiers, actual least-privilege IAM/resource policies and credentials are not supplied by this manifest
Platform SQS receive/delete, stream read permissions, trigger retry/DLQ settings and scheduled reconciliation need deployment configuration; these are not application SDK calls

Presigned URL generation is a signing operation, not an S3 SDK network request; verify the signing identity's object read permission and policies; the URL holder does not need separate AWS credentials
Storage retention/deletion, encryption and logging policies require infrastructure evidence; no retention duration or deletion job is created here
